name: Silvermist, Greater
body:
Aura moderate conjuration; CL 9th; Price +2 bonus; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This armor functions as silver mist armor except that it provides total concealment to the wearer and only normal concealment to other creatures.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor; Spells fog cloud
